findings.summary: The current restaurant-linked menu identifies a current Grilled Chicken Quesadilla variant and describes flour tortilla and cheese, but supplies no complete allergen declaration. It cannot directly verify the frozen baseline's gluten and wheat positives. Cheese supports only the narrow milk positive; the page instead directs customers to call for allergy information.

The accessible restaurant-linked ordering menu contains direct food descriptions but no allergen matrix, negative allergen claims, or cross-contact statement; it explicitly instructs customers to call for allergy information. Direct named components support narrow positives only.

terra.summary: Current public evidence verifies the College Park restaurant and all three dishes. Ceviche Mixto Peruano directly names shrimp, white fish, mussels, and calamari, supporting fish and shellfish; Nachos Azteca directly names cheese, supporting milk. The Grilled Quesadilla baseline is represented by a current grilled-chicken variant, but its gluten and wheat claims are not directly supported by a complete allergen source, producing a discrepancy.
